## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits v1.0.0, for example `feat(recorder): add marker chunks`
- [ ] An issue exists for this change, or it is a trivial fix
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests, and bug fixes include a regression test
- [ ] Format changes to `.rec` or `.dump` include a round-trip test
- [ ] Prose follows the writing rules: no em dashes, no parentheses for explanations
- [ ] I read [CODING_STANDARDS.md](../CODING_STANDARDS.md)
